shop.name: Стербруст
shop.metadata_source: https://sterbrust.com/ and the trusted Sterbrust registry snapshot; no legal entity suffix is asserted

availability_rationale.in_stock: Supplier states that the item is in stock and orderable.
availability_rationale.out_of_stock: Trusted selected offer is retained, but it is not currently available.
availability_rationale.preorder: Partner-ST Schema.org PreOrder explicitly represents an orderable preorder.
availability_rationale.incoming: Arrival alone does not prove that an order can currently be accepted.
availability_rationale.backorder: Optimum on-request and supplier backorder states represent an orderable offer.
availability_rationale.unknown: Fail-safe mapping: unknown supplier state is not advertised as available.
availability_rationale.discontinued: Not orderable and forbidden in selected state by Stage 4 policy.

snapshot_timestamp_source: persisted selection evaluated_at; then completed Stage 5 combined feed run; then selected offer/source timestamps; never wall clock
